title: Video & Music Downloader
summary: Video & music player, no ads. HD, all formats, lyrics, offline & downloads.
description:
VidTube is a clean video and music player — with downloads when you need them — and no ads while you play.

Open a video and it comes to life — with poster art, title and details filled in automatically. Point it at your music and it turns into a beautiful library, with cover art, auto-sorting and real-time synced lyrics. Just open and play.

▶ Video player for every format
One player for everything you've got. A dual playback engine opens virtually any video or audio file, so clips that won't play elsewhere just work.
- Smooth HD and 4K playback
- Plays all formats — mp4, mkv, avi, mov, wmv, m3u8, webm and more
- Poster art and info added automatically for your movies and shows
- Auto-matched subtitles, with dual-subtitle display
- Playback speed control, loop, and background play
- Floating pop-up player for multitasking

♫ Music player with real-time lyrics
More than a media player. Point it at the songs on your device and it does the rest:
- Real-time, synced lyrics that follow along as the song plays
- Cover art, artist and album info added automatically
- Your music auto-sorted into a clean library by artist, album and playlist
- Background playback, shuffle, repeat and offline music listening
- No ads interrupting your music

⤓ Downloads, when you need them
VidTube can save media for offline playback too. A handy video downloader and music downloader with a built-in download manager:
- Fast multi-threaded downloads
- Pause, resume and background downloading
- Download multiple files at once
- Choose resolution — small to save space, or HD for quality
- Save video or extract audio as mp3
Everything you save plays right inside the app — no extra tools needed.

🔒 Yours, and private
Manage, rename and share all your files in one place, lock private videos in a password-protected folder, and switch between light and dark themes.

Your videos. Your music. No ads while you play — and downloads whenever you need them. That's VidTube.
